title: Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach

scenes.headline: 0-60 in 2.7 Seconds
scenes.narration: With a blistering sprint to sixty in just 2.7 seconds, the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach is a stunning feat of engineering.

scenes.headline: Racing Pedigree
scenes.narration: The GT2 RS Weissach pays homage to Porsche’s motorsport legacy, with its rear wing optimizing aerodynamic performance honed on the track.

scenes.headline: 700 Horsepower
scenes.narration: A twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-six engine unleashes 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. It's pure power.

scenes.headline: Rear-Wheel Drive
scenes.narration: This beast channels its power to the rear wheels, enhancing agility and cornering precision.

scenes.headline: Ferrari 488 Pista Rival
scenes.narration: With 700 hp against the Ferrari 488 Pista's 711, the GT2 RS still impresses with a 10.3-second quarter mile versus Ferrari’s 10.5.

scenes.headline: Carbon Fiber Interior
scenes.narration: Inside, carbon fiber dominates the cockpit, emphasizing its lightweight construction and performance pedigree.

scenes.headline: $293K -> $400K
scenes.narration: The GT2 RS started around $293K and now trades for about $400K, appreciating around 8% annually.
So, is the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach's blend of track-bred power and status worth it to you?

script: With a blistering sprint to sixty in just 2.7 seconds, the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach is a stunning feat of engineering. The GT2 RS Weissach pays homage to Porsche’s motorsport legacy, with its rear wing optimizing aerodynamic performance honed on the track. A twin-turbocharged 3.8-liter flat-six engine unleashes 700 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. It's pure power. This beast channels its power to the rear wheels, enhancing agility and cornering precision. With 700 hp against the Ferrari 488 Pista's 711, the GT2 RS still impresses with a 10.3-second quarter mile versus Ferrari’s 10.5. Inside, carbon fiber dominates the cockpit, emphasizing its lightweight construction and performance pedigree. The GT2 RS started around $293K and now trades for about $400K, appreciating around 8% annually. So, is the Porsche 911 GT2 RS Weissach's blend of track-bred power and status worth it to you?
